claims.hypothesis: Is the polarization in inner cores due to k-RATs or self-scattering?
claims.experiment: HRO vs Stokes I gradient, spectral index, brightness temperature, comparison with models
claims.result: broad HRO distribution, polarization pattern inconsistent with models
claims.finding: neither self-scattering nor k-RATs occurs; B-RATs assumed dominant

evidence.quote: we conclude that neither self-scattering nor grain alignment via $k$-RATs is occurring in our sources.

claims.hypothesis: Does the magnetic field follow outflow cavity walls?
claims.experiment: HRO of B-field vs dust and CO gradients
claims.result: HRO peaks near 90 deg in Emb 8(N)

evidence.quote: all peak at $\sim 90^\circ$

claims.hypothesis: What enables enhanced polarization along cavity walls?
claims.experiment: gas column density and photon penetration depth estimates
claims.result: UV cannot penetrate deep; ~300 au thick polarized wall
claims.finding: large (>10 um) grains aligned by longer-wavelength photons required

evidence.quote: our observations suggest that a population of large, \> 10 $\ensuremath{\mu}m$-sized dust grains should be present in the cavity walls
